name: launchproof
description: Claude Code and Codex plugin that makes a finished project public-ready on GitHub: full-history hygiene scan, evidence-backed README, community files, CI, llms.txt, Pages with JSON-LD, scored checklist and a launch plan.

paragraphs: launchproof is a Claude Code and Codex plugin that turns a finished project folder into a public-ready GitHub repo and a launch plan, with every claim backed by evidence in the repo. It scans the whole git history for personal emails, home paths, secrets and private names, writes the README, community files, CI, llms.txt, AGENTS.md and a GitHub Pages page, scores the result with a checklist and fixes the gaps, then drafts posts for every launch channel that fits. It never pushes, publishes or posts: those steps come back to you as exact commands to approve.
